en.眉间旧月一道影。: A shadow of the old moon between the brows.
en.翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙。: Graceful as a startled goose, elegant as a swimming dragon.

en.与你千里之行都付不及记忆的孤寂。: All journeys of a thousand miles with you are paid off in the solitude that memory cannot reach.
en.你是我今与昔的挥影一个人的泪迹。: You are the shadow of my past and present, the tear trace of one person.
en.你是我心与忆的挥影一个人的泪迹。: You are the shadow of my heart and memory, a single trail of tears.
en.依稀欠你的情都付不及记忆的哭泣。: Vaguely owing you affection, unable to pay with the weeping of memory.
en.只身一去天地为家何惧远遥。: Going alone, heaven and earth become home, fearing not the distance.
en.唯独有刀柄与默念千次百次的姓名。: Only the hilt of the sword and the name whispered a thousand times.
en.是我亦不想寻找，: It is that I do not wish to seek,
en.是我向你的剑胆敢忘记我的回忆，: It is that I dare forget my memories with your sword's courage,
en.是我向你的剑都赴不及我的回忆，: It is I who rush to your sword, yet cannot reach my own memories.
en.瞥过它多锋利不悔今昔最深的执意，: Glancing at how sharp it is, no regret for the deepest resolve of past and present,
en.社稷无稷妇孺饥可易，: The state has no grain, women and children starve, easily swapped,
en.社稷无稷日月将更易，: The state has no grain, the sun and moon will change,
en.终抵时如何才能彻底甘心将其放弃。: When finally arriving, how to completely be willing to give it up.
en.若此一去各处为家不畏远遥。: If this departure makes every place home, fearing not the distance.
en.蝗过无际兵过如刀剃。: Locusts pass without end, soldiers pass like a razor shave.
en.蝗过无际饿殍遍千里。: Locusts pass without end, corpses of the hungry spread across a thousand li.
en.诸公无闻黎民生死怎在意。: The gentlemen hear nothing, how do they care for the lives and deaths of the common people.
en.这一路崎岖或遇荆棘都不曾在意，: This road is rugged, encountering thorns, never caring,
en.那切骨之怨都赴不及心里的涟漪，: That bone-cutting resentment cannot reach the ripples in the heart.
en.那散落一切都补不及昔日的回忆，: That scattered everything cannot make up for the memories of the past,
en.黄埃无地人烟断如雨，: Yellow dust covers the ground, human smoke cuts off, raining down,
en.黄埃无地白骨遭遗弃，: Yellow dust covers the ground, white bones abandoned,

en.与我缱绻一身桃花片 与我缠作相思茧: With me, entangled in a body of peach blossom petals; with me, twisted into a cocoon of lovesickness.
en.且容我 游曳偷闲: Let me wander and steal a moment of leisure
en.五百由旬褪尽脱 白骨雕朱颜: After five hundred yojanas, the white bones shed to carve a crimson face
en.人设：葬雪荒城: Character Design: Zang Xue Huang Cheng
en.人间大梦连天 杀伐过眼 蹉跎多许年: A mortal dream stretches across the sky; the killing and slaughter pass before my eyes, wasting many years.
en.人间情字如麻 爱字最弗堪: Human emotions are as tangled as hemp, but the word "love" is the most unbearable.
en.人颤颤意潺潺 指尖眉尖: Trembling people, murmuring thoughts; fingertips and eyebrows
en.今宵烟花剪碎 婉转谢弗堪: Tonight the fireworks are snipped apart, turning a graceful farewell that is hard to bear
en.何妨苦海偷欢 一遇一见就相干: Why not steal joy from the bitter sea? One meeting, one encounter, and we are intertwined.
en.何必纠结为谁执念 为谁挥洒千年: Why dwell on obsession for one or pour a thousand years in devotion for another?
en.何必计较去日阑珊 何必怨地尤天: Why dwell on the fading past, or blame the earth and heaven?
en.哪怕罚作灯芯一捻 从头絮絮吹: Even if punished to be a mere wick, I'll blow softly from the beginning
en.哪怕罚作烛影一闪 灭后趁夜欢: Even if punished to be a flicker of candlelight, after extinguishing, I'll enjoy the night
en.啥物煞弗堪 何谓永远: What is unbearable, what is eternal?
en.天枢易折 天机易断 人间调人间: Heavenly Pivot Easily Broken, Heavenly Secrets Easily Severed, Mortals Tune Mortals.
en.弗如再苦海厮缠一千年: Better to be entangled in the sea of bitterness for another thousand years.
en.弗必清算忐忑机关 弗必唤孽呼冤: No need to settle the anxious schemes, no need to call out sin or cry injustice
en.弗识苦 弗晓甜 不过随心从所愿: Unaware of bitterness, ignorant of sweetness, simply following the heart's desires.
en.心潮散漫 梦无遮拦 风月当无边: Heart's tide scattered, dreams unobstructed; wind and moon should be boundless
en.恻恻思悠悠念 弗着半点: Deeply pensive, endlessly yearning, not a single thought misplaced
en.我攀过卅三日天 云雨盘桓雾里叹: I climbed thirty-three days of sky, clouds and rain lingering, sighing within the mist
en.我流连廿八曜日 吸星晒月苦周旋: I linger through twenty-eight days, sucking stars and basking in the moon, struggling through it all
en.我淘桃花揉碎 沉湎恋弗堪: I sift through peach blossoms, crushing them, lost in a love too deep to bear.
en.拥弗牢 生死流年: Clinging not tightly, life and death flowing through the years
en.攒我千年 赐侬一眼 余生侪看遍: Accumulating my thousand years to grant you a glance; the rest of our lives shall be seen together
en.曲绘：葬雪荒城、 Ar极光、积雨云: Illustration: Zang Xue Huang Cheng, Ar Jiguang, Jiyuyun
en.有缘无缘谁敢妄断 相见哪能幸免: Whether fate brings us together or apart, who dares to rashly decide? Meeting cannot be spared from this fate
en.有缘无缘谁配裁判 相见合该恨晚: Whether fate brings us together or apart, who dares to judge? Meeting should have been regretted for being too late
en.生如华宴 死如梦幻 如何弗贪恋: Life is like a grand banquet, death like a dream; how can one not be greedy for it?
en.笑夜折腰 怜昼苦短 宝髻怀中偏: Laughing at night, bowing the waist; pitying the shortness of the day; the ornate hairpin rests in my arms.
en.红尘畔三生三世 顽石穿几穿: By the side of the red dust, three lives and three worlds; how many times must the stubborn stone be pierced?
en.绮罗遮颜 胭脂覆面 声色镜中湮: Fine silks cover the face; rouge masks the visage; within the mirror of sound and color, all fades away.
en.翻调：雪螢SiqYin 翻和声：莉莉紫: Pitch Adjustment: Xue Ying SiqYin; Harmony Arrangement: Li Li Zi
en.血沁残喘 最瀴再最甜: Blood-soaked, gasping for breath; the most lingering, the sweetest.
en.行无路 渡无船 片刻青春弗值钿: No path to walk, no boat to cross; a moment of youth is not worth a coin
en.赌我千年 调谁一眼 输赢侪潋滟: Betting my thousand years for a glance from you; whether we win or lose, the waters shimmer together
en.非是劫 非是缘 只是情愿兑心甘: Not a calamity, not a fate, simply a willing exchange of heart and mind
